purpose: Define the exact recovery path for validating, promoting, committing and pushing the Mega Drive AAA video curation package after local command execution becomes available.

historical_blocker.observed_behavior: Earlier, local shell commands failed before process execution.
historical_blocker.effect: While active, the validator, git status, commit, push and any workspace audit command could not be proven; local command execution has since been restored and validate_aaa_video_curation.ps1 prints PASSED.
historical_blocker.status_impact: A package-validator PASS is not ROM/emulator proof, so all curation artifacts remain candidate_applied_not_verified until build/emulator runtime evidence exists.

recovery_steps.action: Restore local process execution in the Codex/PowerShell runner.
required_evidence: command output is visible to the agent
recovery_steps.forbidden_shortcut: Do not assume runner recovery without a successful command.

recovery_steps.action: Run the AAA video curation validator.
recovery_steps.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat validator script existence as validator pass.

recovery_steps.action: Run relevant workspace methodology/context/hygiene/freshness/learning audits required by AGENTS.md for this curation scope.
required_evidence: blocking findings resolved or explicitly recorded
recovery_steps.forbidden_shortcut: Do not replace workspace audits with the curation validator.

recovery_steps.action: Promote only the curation package status, not game/runtime/AAA release status.
required_evidence: workspace audits pass or non-blocking status recorded

recovery_steps.action: Commit the validated curation package with a clear message.
recovery_steps.forbidden_shortcut: Do not claim commit without git output.

recovery_steps.action: Push the commit to the configured remote/branch when available.
required_evidence: remote branch updated or push blocker recorded
recovery_steps.forbidden_shortcut: Do not claim push without git output.

explicit_non_goals: This plan does not validate any ROM.
This plan does not validate any generated sprite sheet.
This plan does not replace BlastEm/VDP evidence for game delivery.
This plan does not verify the full external 64-video corpus.
